title: The Earth: A Prison or a Blessing?
next: A Prayer in a Barren Valley

narration: Is this world a prison? Or is it a blessing?
Your answer shapes how you earn, spend and build.

lines.text: Your answer shapes how you earn, spend and build.

narration: Quran and Global Economy. Episode two: the creation worldview. Is the earth a prison, or a blessing?
Our economic mindset begins with how we see this world.
In the Biblical view, coming to earth is a punishment and a curse.
Hard labour, disease and agriculture are the results of that curse.
And man is a prisoner in this world.

items.text: Coming to earth is a punishment and a curse
Hard labour, disease and agriculture are results of that curse
Man is a prisoner in this world

narration: In the Quranic view, being sent to earth is not a curse. It is a provision from Allah.
The earth holds abundant resources and blessings for humans.
And our purpose here is gratitude, and using these blessings.

items.text: Being sent to earth is not a curse, but a provision from Allah
The earth holds abundant resources and blessings
Our purpose: gratitude, and using these blessings

narration: When Adam was sent down, the Quran says: and for you on the earth is a place of settlement, and provision for a time.

props.arabic: وَلَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُسۡتَقَرّٞ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
props.english: And you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time.

narration: We have established you upon the earth, and made for you therein ways of livelihood.

props.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنَّـٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَۗ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
props.english: We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood. Little are you grateful.

narration: And Allah told the angels: indeed, I will make upon the earth a khalifah.

props.english: Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority (khalifah).

narration: So developing the world economically, and succeeding in it, is part of being a khalifah on earth.

lines.text: Developing the world economically and succeeding in it
is part of being a khalifah on earth.
